title: Pigpen third-party listing
description: One file listings/<id>.json: a PiG Package or Piglet that Pigpen does not own, pinned to a full commit. node scripts/generate-index.mjs turns it into an index.json entry with official: false and the maintainer named here.

id.description: The index id and the file name (listings/<id>.json). Never the id of a Pigpen Piglet or component.

maintainer.description: The real maintainer: the person or organisation that owns the repository. Never Pigpen's owner.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit hash the listing is pinned to. This is the pin: a branch, HEAD or an abbreviated hash is refused.

tag.description: Optional human label for the commit. A tag can be moved, so it never replaces commit; scripts/verify-listings.mjs fails when the tag no longer points at commit.

subdirectory.description: Where the Package or Piglet lives inside the repository, relative, with / separators.

license.description: The SPDX license expression the repository's own license file at the pinned commit grants, for example MIT or Apache-2.0 OR MIT.

version.description: A Package: the version in its package.json at the pinned commit. Not used for a Piglet.

resources.description: A Package: the Resources its package.json declares at the pinned commit. scripts/verify-listings.mjs compares them with the installed Package.

verified.description: The PiG this listing was last verified with by scripts/verify-listings.mjs, and when.
